name: 파일
description: 프로젝트의 파일 트리와 즐겨찾기를 사이드바에 보여 준다. 카드 표면은 없다.

status.name: files.tree
status.description: The visible rows of the file tree, each with its path, kind, depth, expansion and selection, and the message row text or null.

status.name: files.bookmarks
status.description: The bookmarked paths of the project in stored order.

commands.name: files.refresh
commands.description: Lists the project folder and every expanded directory again.

commands.name: files.bookmarks.add
commands.description: Adds a path relative to the project folder to the bookmarks unless it is already there.

commands.name: files.select
commands.description: Selects a path of the file tree, or clears the selection with null.

commands.name: files.open
commands.description: Opens a file of the project folder through core.file.open, which runs the plugin that declares the extension of the file.

commands.name: files.open.failed
commands.description: Records the failure to open a file from the file tree as files.open. The same text again changes nothing.

commands.name: files.tree.toggle
commands.description: Expands or collapses a folder of the file tree: the sidecar lists the folder or stops listing it, and the tree shows its reply. expanded is the state that the tree library shows.

dom.name: files.tree.refresh
dom.description: The refresh button of the file tree header, which lists the project folder again.

dom.name: files.bookmarks.add
dom.description: The star button of the file tree header, which adds the selected file to the bookmarks.

dom.name: files.bookmarks.item
dom.description: One bookmarked path of the bookmarks list.

dom.name: files.bookmarks.remove
dom.description: The remove button of one bookmarked path.
